Subject: Clarification on Expense Reporting Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to clarify the expense reporting process we follow. This procedure is designed to ensure that all financial transactions are accurately recorded and submitted for reimbursement in a timely manner.

Upon receipt of an expense report, the Accounts Payable team reviews it to verify that all expenses comply with our company’s policies and are supported by valid documentation. Please ensure that all receipts and supporting documents are included with your submission. 

If you have any questions or need further clarification, I would appreciate it if you could reach out to me directly. Your feedback is valuable in improving our process and ensuring its effectiveness.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]  
[Company Name]
